frame_roster_rule.timestamp_token_rule: exact suffix after the final underscore, parsed by Decimal to integer nanoseconds; exponent, negative, sub-nanosecond and same-ns alias tokens are rejected
frame_roster_rule.exact_frame_denominator: all source stems present in color/highres_depth/lowres_depth/confidence, with exact-stem pincam and an in-domain pose bracket of at most 0.25 seconds
frame_roster_rule.ordering: ascending exact timestamp nanoseconds, then original token

phase_order.step_1: validate every bound asset and freeze every parent exact-frame denominator
phase_order.step_2: decode every exact ADAPTER_FIT frame from all eight fit parents
phase_order.step_3: fit and seal the factory-bound uncertainty model while eval payload decode count remains zero
phase_order.step_4: decode all exact O0R_EVAL_CANDIDATE frames and derive source eligibility
phase_order.step_5: build exactly nine FARO truth query bundles for every source-eligible frame

query_uncertainty_lookup_rule.depth_source: registered FARO sampled at frozen AppleDepth pixel centers
query_uncertainty_lookup_rule.confidence_source: bound AppleDepth confidence at the same sampled pixels
query_uncertainty_lookup_rule.common_support: valid FARO samples whose unprojected points have inclusive along-path coordinate from minimum_forward_m through exactly horizon_m and ground-projected perpendicular distance at most capsule_radius_m
query_uncertainty_lookup_rule.upper_endpoint_rule: exactly horizon_m inclusive; GEOMETRY_ENDPOINT_TOLERANCE_M is not added to uncertainty lookup support
query_uncertainty_lookup_rule.support_plane_height_gate: none; on-support-plane means ground-projected perpendicular corridor distance, not an additional absolute-height filter
query_uncertainty_lookup_rule.confidence_value: highest confidence index among modes over query common support
query_uncertainty_lookup_rule.range_m: median FARO z over the same query common support

source_member_provenance_envelope.canonical_mapping_rule: official {video_id}_{timestamp_token} members are never presented as original timestamp-only members; the outer envelope binds the original path and an explicit canonical path used by the frozen in-memory adapter

persistence_contract.array_storage: deterministic little-endian canonical bytes compressed with gzip mtime=0
persistence_contract.json_payload: canonical JSON with every ndarray replaced by a content-addressed blob reference
persistence_contract.round_trip_gate: hydrate every blob, verify blob SHA/bytes/shape/dtype, then require the hydrated artifact canonical SHA-256 to equal the in-memory source-adapter artifact SHA-256
